canonical_definition: Reconcile the complete accumulated CMP-4 scientific compute framework against current main, establish one exact merge-candidate implementation SHA, run the required Level 3 qualification once, preserve durable evidence, and hand off to CMP-5 — External distributed-compute adapters.
